summary: Completed targeted P0 backend-only freshness/cache boundary coverage requested after iteration_48, without rerunning broad suites or modifying application code.

Revision increment correctly invalidates process-warm cache entries and forces recompute without request-path DB writes.

Compact projection explain comparison shows same docs/keys examined (old/new both 100810 docs, 100811 keys); execution time increased in this run (331ms -> 418ms), so no cold-speedup claim should be made.
Real bounded maxTimeMS behavior validated (maxTimeMS=1): direct Mongo timeout observed and API returns retryable 503 price_query_timeout under bounded snapshot query limit.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_48 and historical pre-fix artifacts were preserved (not overwritten). New focused coverage lives in test_p0_cache_boundaries.py and emits supplementary JSONs under /app/test_reports/p0_my_products/. rca of the issue: No new functional regressions were found in this targeted run. Prior instability in boundary testing came from fixture-time coupling near expiry; deterministic cohort-validity boundary assertions were added so behavior fails reliably if 7d/180d rules regress.
